maddeler.e:
أختصم (form VIII)
# أَخْتَصِمُ (ʔaḵtaṣimu) /ʔax.ta.sˤi.mu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِخْتَصَمَ (iḵtaṣama)
# أَخْتَصِمَ (ʔaḵtaṣima) /ʔax.ta.sˤi.ma/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِخْتَصَمَ (iḵtaṣama)
# أَخْتَصِمْ (ʔaḵtaṣim) /ʔax.ta.sˤim/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِخْتَصَمَ (iḵtaṣama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
